title: Pseudorabies Virus Injection into Interscapular Brown Adipose Tissue
author: Heike Muenzberg
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.w2vfge6
materials: Inject bupivacaine/lidocaine subcutaneously around the incision site.
Inject warm saline intraperitoneal for rehydration.

steps.title: Prepare Surgery Environment and Safety
steps.instruction: Set up the surgery platform and ensure BSL2 safety compliance.

substeps.instruction: Perform all work in BSL2 laboratories and keep injected mice in BSL2 housing until euthanasia.
Label all containers in contact with virus waste as biohazard waste.
Ensure virus stock is kept on ice during surgeries.
Transport virus using double-containers (e.g., Eppendorf tube inside a 50ml Falcon tube) per IBC safety rules.
Place a sterile towel on the surgery platform over the heating mat and another sterile towel in the anesthesia induction chamber.

steps.title: Calculate Dosages and Prepare Syringes
steps.instruction: Record the mouse's body weight and prepare the following solutions:

substeps.instruction: Warm saline: 1-1.5 ml for 25 g body weight.
Bupivacaine/lidocaine: 2.5-12.5 mg/kg body weight.
Carprofen: 5-10 mg/kg body weight.

steps.title: Induce and Maintain Anesthesia
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the mouse and monitor depth.

substeps.instruction: Induce anesthesia with 5% isoflurane in the induction chamber.
Place the mouse on the surgery platform and maintain anesthesia via a nose cone at 1.5-2% Isoflurane/oxygen, adjusting for breathing and anesthetic depth (e.g., loss of withdrawal reflex).
Apply eye lubricant to the mouse's eyes.
Check for full withdrawal reflex to ensure anesthetic depth.

steps.title: Prepare the Injection Site
steps.instruction: Clean and expose the interscapular brown adipose tissue (iBAT).

substeps.instruction: Disinfect the lower back with 70% ethanol prior to subcutaneous carprofen injection.
Shave the interscapular region using a clipper to remove all hair.
Disinfect the skin using three alternating scrubs of Novalsan followed by 70% Isopropyl rubbing alcohol.
Make a midline incision with sharp scissors from the scapula to the neck.
Remove connective tissue under the incision using a sterile cotton swab and teethed forceps until the iBAT depot is accessible.
Detach the rostral portion of the iBAT depot from the interscapular muscle and flip the iBAT lobe back from the rostral side to expose the main iBAT vein (Sulzer vein) and the ventral iBAT site.

steps.title: Prepare Virus Injection
steps.instruction: Prepare the virus under a biological safety cabinet (BSC).

substeps.instruction: Fill a Hamilton syringe with 500nl PRV-152 virus within the BSC.
Cover the iBAT with a saline-soaked sterile gauze to prevent the tissue from drying.

steps.title: Perform iBAT Injections
steps.instruction: Inject the virus into the brown adipose tissue.

substeps.instruction: Remove the saline-soaked gauze from the iBAT and locate the pad.
Place five injections of 100nl (5x100nl) into the right BAT.
Hold the syringe in place for ~30 seconds after each injection to minimize backflow.
Slowly pull the syringe out of the BAT while holding a sterile cotton swab on the injection site to dry any possible virus leakage.

steps.title: Post-Injection Cleaning and Closure
steps.instruction: Clean the equipment and close the surgical site.

substeps.instruction: Place sterile saline-soaked gauze on top of the iBAT.
Clean the syringe under the BSC with 70% ethanol; flush the syringe approximately 10x with 70% ethanol, then approximately 10x with sterile H2O (collect all liquid as biohazard waste).
Remove the saline-soaked gauze from the iBAT.
Reposition the overlaying white adipose tissue to its original location using a sterile cotton swab and teethed forceps.
Align both sides of the incision with teethed and tissue forceps and apply wound clips approximately 25 mm apart.

steps.title: Recovery and Tool Sterilization
steps.instruction: Monitor the mouse and sterilize tools for subsequent use.

substeps.instruction: Place the unconscious mouse in a fresh cage with approximately half of the cage on a heating mat; monitor until startling reflexes are restored.
Clean surgery tools with 70% ethanol and place in a glass bead sterilizer for 15-20 seconds before additional surgeries.
